known_facts_book1: A boy of the Country of the Gillikins in the north of Oz, reared from infancy by the witch Mombi, whom he frankly hates.
His full name is Tippetarius, shortened to Tip; he remembers nothing of his parents.
Carves a pumpkin head and builds a wooden man to frighten Mombi, then names it Jack Pumpkinhead.
Watches Mombi bring Jack to life with the Powder of Life she got from a crooked wizard.
Learns Mombi means to transform him into a marble statue, so he steals the Powder of Life and runs away with Jack that night.
Brings the Saw-Horse to life with the Powder of Life to carry Jack, imitating Mombi's words and gestures.
Heads south toward the Emerald City; is separated from Jack when the Saw-Horse bolts, and reunites at the city gates.
Falls in with General Jinjur on the road, carries her army's baskets, and witnesses the girls' conquest of the Emerald City.
Escapes the captured city on the Saw-Horse, tied to the Scarecrow and Jack, and journeys to the Tin Woodman.
Brings the Gump, a patchwork flying Thing, to life with the last of the Powder of Life to escape Jinjur's palace by air.
Swallows a Wishing Pill and, in pain, wishes he had never swallowed it, which undoes the wish and refills the box.
Is the only human of the party and the only one who tires, sleeps, and grows hungry.
Is revealed at the very end to be Princess Ozma: as an infant, Ozma was transformed into the boy Tip by Mombi at the Wizard's bidding.
At first refuses the reveal, wanting to stay a boy and keep travelling with his friends, then consents to have the enchantment undone.
Is restored by Mombi's incantation into a young girl, Princess Ozma, and crowned rightful Queen of the Emerald City.

known_relations_book1.Mombi: The witch who reared him and whom he hates; she meant to make him a marble statue, and years earlier she transformed the infant Ozma into Tip. His enchanter and guardian, not his mother.
known_relations_book1.Jack Pumpkinhead: His own creation, who calls Tip 'father'; Tip made and repeatedly repairs him. When Tip becomes a girl the father-son relationship ends.
known_relations_book1.Saw-Horse: Brought to life by Tip and his loyal steed; on the reveal it becomes Ozma's personal property.
known_relations_book1.Scarecrow: Befriends Tip on the journey and remains his faithful friend after the reveal.
known_relations_book1.Nick Chopper: The Tin Woodman, who befriends Tip and reassures him that being a girl is no misfortune.
known_relations_book1.Woggle-Bug: Travelling companion who offers to become Tip's tutor once he is a girl again.
known_relations_book1.Glinda: Takes a great liking to Tip; forces Mombi to reveal his identity and oversees his restoration as Princess Ozma.
known_relations_book1.Pastoria: Tip is Pastoria's daughter Ozma, the lost heir to the Emerald City throne.

transformation_facts: Glinda transforms Tip into a girl (it is Mombi, not Glinda, who works the transformation)
Tip and Ozma are two separate people
relationships: Ozma is married to the Scarecrow
Ozma befriends Dorothy in this book

hallucination_signals: Glinda transforms Tip into a girl
